preregistered.estimates: per data circuit, the raw selector contrast P(s=0 | coin read 1) - P(s=0 | coin read 0) with its binomial standard error, and the visibility of the center arm of each scan batch
preregistered.guard: a data batch is admitted when q11's e01 and e10 each change by at most 0.02 between the readout batch before it and the one after; the decision needs at least one admitted batch of every scan kind, otherwise it reads unresolved_guard
preregistered.control: the inverse-variance mean of the center arm's contrast over the admitted scan batches exceeds 3.0 standard errors, otherwise the offset is absent and no mechanism is decided
preregistered.fit: per admitted scan batch and world, the least chi-square of the batch's three contrasts over the world's one parameter, at the retention that reproduces the center arm's visibility through the mean assignment matrix of the two brackets; a world's chi-square is the sum over the admitted scan batches
preregistered.adequate: a world is adequate when its chi-square is at most the 0.999 quantile of the chi-square law with two degrees of freedom per admitted batch
preregistered.class: three classes of worlds: a rotation about x added to the pulses (on all pulses, on q8's or on q4's), a rotation about y or z added before or after them (same scopes), and the two selector readout worlds; a class is preferred when its best world is adequate and the best world of each other class sits at least 25.0 above it; the x class is excluded when the two other classes lead, the leader is adequate and the best x world sits at least 25.0 above it
preregistered.bridge: Rx(pi/2) reproduces X90 when the within-batch difference of the b0-rx and b0 contrasts, pooled over the two bridge batches, is within 3.0 standard errors of zero
preregistered.qx: every circuit within twice the sampling floor of its ideal law
